mutual_distinction: Schema evolution, OOXML formula structure, event-time state, expiry stock allocation and three-version text edits are separate products/users/contracts. Shared packaging is infrastructure.

user: Spreadsheet export developers inspecting missing or surprising shared-formula cells.
pain: A shared follower can omit its formula text, making raw ZIP inspection misleading; caches can be stale.
capability: Inspect XLSX shared-formula groups and expand supported A1 references with structural findings and master-cell evidence.
expected: The generated real workbook expands B3 to A3+$A$1.
limits: Read-only conventional xl/worksheets/*.xml parts in transitional OOXML; 4MiB compressed AND total uncompressed ZIP,100 entries,16 worksheets,5000 cells per sheet,8192 formula characters. Strict UTF-8 worksheet XML, no DTD/entities/duplicate archive paths or cells. Master is the unique ref-bearing shared member; follower text is overridden. Outside-range members and overlapping master ranges are findings. Lexical A1 translation supports absolute/relative coordinates, ranges, quoted strings, numbers, function tokens, operators and TRUE/FALSE. Names, sheet/external/table references, translated out-of-bounds references are reported unsupported. This is NOT a formula grammar validator/evaluator, cache-freshness check, full XLSX validator or relationship resolver. Nonshared/array/data-table formulas are listed but not analyzed. Missing nonshared cells inside a shared range are not invented or treated as shared. No Excel application execution.
distinct: Existing CSV and accounting tools do not inspect OOXML shared master/follower structures. This reads a real spreadsheet package and never evaluates or changes it.
